name: hookpoint-opportunity-radar
description: Connector-ready warm-lead intelligence and activation system for Hook Point and Hyper Ads.

scripts.test:postgres: bash -o pipefail -c '[ -n "${RADAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}" ] || { echo "test:postgres: set DATABASE_URL or RADAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL" >&2; exit 1; }; RADAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL="${RADAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}" node --test --test-reporter=spec'
scripts.check: bash -o pipefail -c 'for dir in src test; do [ -d "$dir" ] || { echo "check: expected source directory \"$dir\" is missing" >&2; exit 1; }; done; find src test -name "*.js" -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check'
